items: Better Maps: Added an experimental Plan tab to help you find your remaining map mice
Better Maps: Solver links skip caught mice, and Sorted tab popups stay on screen
Better Travel: Favorite locations appear first on the travel page and in Simple Travel
Better Marketplace: Price history charts remember if you left them collapsed
Better Inventory: More Magic Essence warnings, with suggestions for other recipes
Better Journal: Item links support plural names, and Zokor entries show which Thief Base you used
Location HUDs - Cerulean Skyport: Raid progress bars change color as you gather intel
Location HUDs - Gnawnian Express Station: The train board remembers if you left it open or minimized
Location HUDs - Zokor: The Thief Base toggle shows the mode you’re switching to
Keyboard Shortcuts: Escape cancels an edit, and Backspace or Delete clears the shortcut
Favorite Setups: Crafting bait clears missing-item warnings. Empty bait and charm slots now disarm those items
Favorite Setups: Setups with an unowned charm arm without it, and the item picker is more compact
Fixed timers when your account and computer use different time zones
Keyboard Shortcuts: Disarming your charm no longer disarms your bait
Better Gifts: The "ignore bad gifts" setting works again
Send Supplies: Fixed page reloads when pressing Enter and duplicate sends
Better Shops: Quantity buttons update the purchase total
Custom Background: Event backgrounds appear again when set to Default
Custom Shield: Fixed shields for titles like Grand Duke
Inventory Lock and Hide: Hidden items stay hidden in the trap selector
Journal Changer: Fixed issues with changing and remembering themes
Journal Privacy: Names stay hidden as new entries appear
Quick Filters and Sort: Changing the sort keeps your filter
Dark Mode: Fixed styles for inventory confirmations, gift selectors, and more
Other small fixes and style tweaks
